title: Research Admission January 2027 (M.S. and Ph.D.)
field: Engineering, sciences, data science and AI

compensation.value: PhD (HTRA) Institute Fellowship Rs 37,000 per month (years 1-2) and Rs 42,000 per month (years 3-5), plus HRA as per GoI norms
compensation.evidence_quote: PhD HTRA scholars are eligible for Institute Fellowship of Rs.37,000/- per month for the first two years and Rs.42,000/- per month for the next three years

about: IIT Madras admits M.S. by Research and Ph.D. scholars for January 2027, including data science and AI programmes. Online applications close 30 October 2026 at 5:00 p.m.; departments then run written tests and interviews.
requirements: Engineering PhD: postgraduate degree in engineering/technology
Science PhD: master's degree with a valid GATE score or UGC-JRF/NET/CSIR-JRF/NBHM/INSPIRE/JEST or equivalent
Separate eligible-degree rules for PhD and MS in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
Foreign nationals may apply but are not eligible for the Half-Time Research Assistantship
Departments conduct written tests and interviews

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "M.S. by Research / PhD" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Separate eligible-degree rules for PhD and MS in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."

"Departments conduct written tests and interviews" → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
